title: Product not registered for the crop
why: ALAKAZAM 500 WG (flonicamid) is registered in Morocco for Agrumes only, not tomatoes: using it on tomatoes is off-label, whatever the EU limit (0.5 mg/kg). DECIS EXPERT (deltamethrin) registered on Tomate, DAR 3, limit 0.1 mg/kg: fine.

title: Import tolerance and a label name written differently
why: MOVENTO 150 OD (spirotetramat) registered on Agrumes, DAR 21 respected; spirotetramat is not approved in the EU but has an import tolerance of 0.5 mg/kg on oranges: shippable with a warning (AMBER). KARATE 5 EC label says 'Lambda cyhalothrine' = EU 'Lambda-cyhalothrin', approved, 0.2 mg/kg on oranges, DAR 7 respected: fine. Ideal verdict AMBER; CANNOT_VERIFY is acceptable for a system that cannot map the label spelling.
